sourceText:
Grilled Broccoli Pizza
By: KC Quaretti-Lee
Published: Wednesday, August 4, 2010 - 11:55am

Ingredients




Package Pizza Dough
2 3 Italian Tomatoes

Preparation

1 Slice tomatoes ¼ inch thick, drizzle with vinegar and roast in 225 degree oven for 35 minutes. 2 Drizzle garlic oil on broccoli and broil for 3-5 minutes. 3 Broccoli should be lightly browned. 4 Rough chop both broccoli and tomatoes but do not mix together. 5 Heat BBQ and spray with non stick spray. 6 Lay dough on grill with heat on low for about 3 minutes. 7 Turn over and top with Tomatoes, broccoli and cheese. 8 Grill approximately 5-7 minutes. Dough will be cooked and cheese melted.
